newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted thinly flat-higher levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted thinly flat-higher levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted at steady to higher levels on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 110 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Five barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of August, bid 115 percent, unchanged from May 16, no offer.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of September, bid 160 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points from May 16, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of October, no bid, offer 225 percent, unchanged from May 16.
